description: Angular component for configuring pie chart widget settings in the Thingsboard platform, extending a base chart settings component and managing form controls for various visual options.

classes.name: PieChartWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for pie chart widget settings, extending LatestChartWidgetSettingsComponent with specific controls and templates.

methods.name: defaultLatestChartSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the pie chart widget.

methods.name: latestChartConfigTemplate
methods.description: Provides the template reference for the pie chart configuration.

methods.name: setupLatestChartControls
methods.description: Initializes form controls for various pie chart settings such as labels, border, radius, and direction.

methods.name: latestChartValidatorTriggers
methods.description: Specifies which form controls trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateLatestChartValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables label-related controls based on the 'showLabel' setting.
